Triggers on macOS app, SwiftUI macOS, SwiftData, Swift concurrency, Foundation Models, Swift Testing, ScreenCaptureKit, screen capture, screen recording, AVFoundation, MenuBarExtra, NSViewRepresentable, notarize, login item, and process monitoring.
